title: Terms & Conditions
description: The rules for using I Need Save: personal use, responsibility for copyright, prohibited uses, service limits, and how to report infringement.
body:
By using I Need Save (ineedsave.com), you agree to the following terms and conditions. If you don't agree, please don't use the service.

About the service

I Need Save is a free tool that helps you download videos, photos, and audio from public content on social media and other sites. We don't store or host that content; files come from their original platforms. I Need Save is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Pinterest, or any other platform. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Permitted use

  • The service is for personal, non-commercial use.
  • Only download content you own, have permission to download, or are allowed to download under the law that applies to you.
  • Also follow the terms of the platform the content comes from.

Copyright and your responsibility

Downloaded content remains the property of its creator. You are fully responsible for how you use the files you download. Don't re-upload, sell, or use other people's content commercially without permission, and always credit the creator.

Prohibited uses

  • Downloading or distributing content that violates the law, copyright, or other people's privacy.
  • Trying to access private or restricted content without the right to do so.
  • Using bots, scripts, or automation to access the service at scale.
  • Disrupting, overloading, or trying to break the security of our servers and service.

Copyright infringement reports

If you own a copyright and believe this service is being used to infringe it, contact us with the link to the content, proof of ownership, and a short explanation. We will review the report and may restrict access to the link concerned.

Availability

The service is provided free of charge and may change, be limited, or be discontinued at any time without notice. Original platforms may also limit or block access, so not every piece of content can always be downloaded.

Disclaimer

The service is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, including any warranty that it will always work, be error-free, or be fit for a particular purpose.

Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any direct or indirect loss arising from your use of the service or from the content you download.

Third-party links

This website contains links to third-party sites and services. We are not responsible for their content or policies.

Changes to these terms

These terms may be updated from time to time. By continuing to use the service after changes are published, you accept the latest version.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.

Contact

Questions and reports can be sent through the contact links at the bottom of every page or via abidhanan.my.id. Please also read our Privacy Policy.
